//: Dated exceptions for scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs — the documentation-rot gate. Every entry needs EITHER an exact `anchor` (the string the gate printed, e.g. `scripts/foo.mjs` or `pnpm run build:x`) OR a `pattern` (a JS regex tested against that string), plus a `reason` explaining why the doc is allowed to name something that does not resolve. `expires` (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional but strongly preferred: an entry past its expiry FAILS the gate deliberately, so an exception is a decision that gets revisited rather than a permanent hole. `files` is an optional substring of the doc path, narrowing the entry to one document. An entry that matches nothing is reported as STALE — delete it. Prefer fixing the doc: this list is for anchors that are correct to write down even though they cannot resolve on disk (paths a consumer creates, files a generator emits at build time, and TOMBSTONES — a doc naming what was deliberately deleted, in a sentence that says so).

allowed.reason: Build outputs, gitignored and absent on a clean checkout. Docs correctly name dist/, libs/*/dist, story-fixture/dist and styles/dist-v5 when explaining what the build produces. This replaced a ^dist/ pattern that was anchored to the start of the string and so matched NOTHING — every real anchor is libs/<pkg>/dist..., which is why the gate passed locally (where the builds exist) and failed on CI.

Gitignored Figma working artifacts (the variable payload, the last export, the canvas dumps). Only parity-manifest.json and canvas-projection.json are tracked — see .altitude/README.md. FIGMA-SYNC.md correctly names the others while describing the sync loop that produces them.

Exists only on a machine that has created session worktrees; untracked, so absent on a clean checkout. CLAUDE.md names it in the search-scoping rule precisely so an agent EXCLUDES it — the reference has to survive even where the directory does not.

This doc surveys how OTHER AI tools lay out their context directories (Cursor's .ai/memory, Copilot's .github/copilot-instructions) in order to argue for .altitude/. Those paths are correctly absent from this repo — that is the point of the comparison.
